import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { Geist, Geist_Mono } from "next/font/google";
import { Sidebar } from "@/components/layout/sidebar";
import { Header } from "@/components/layout/header";
import "./globals.css";

const geistSans = Geist({
  variable: "--font-geist-sans",
  subsets: ["latin"],
});

const geistMono = Geist_Mono({
  variable: "--font-geist-mono",
  subsets: ["latin"],
});

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "ReleaseBeacon",
  description: "Agent-driven release intelligence platform",
};

export default function RootLayout({
  children,
}: Readonly<{
  children: React.ReactNode;
}>) {
  return (
    <html lang="en">
      <body
        className={`${geistSans.variable} ${geistMono.variable} antialiased`}
      >
        <div className="flex h-screen">
          <Sidebar />
          <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col overflow-hidden">
            <Header />
            <main className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6">{children}</main>
          </div>
        </div>
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}
```

**Key Features:**
- Uses Geist font family from Google Fonts
- Two-column layout: collapsible sidebar + main content area
- Header displays dynamic page title
- Full-height design with proper scrolling for main content

    --border: oklch(0.922 0 0);                    /* Light border */
    --input: oklch(0.922 0 0);
    --ring: oklch(0.708 0 0);
}

.dark {
    /* Dark mode overrides */
    --background: oklch(0.145 0 0);                /* Dark */
    --foreground: oklch(0.985 0 0);                /* Light text */
    --primary: oklch(0.922 0 0);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.205 0 0);
    --destructive: oklch(0.704 0.191 22.216);     /* Bright red */
    --border: oklch(1 0 0 / 10%);                  /* Subtle borders */
}

@layer base {
  * {
    @apply border-border outline-ring/50;
  }
  body {
    @apply bg-background text-foreground;
  }
}
```

**Design System:**
- **OKLch color space** for perceptually uniform colors
- **Light mode**: Dark text on white background
- **Dark mode**: Light text on dark background
- **Border radius**: 0.625rem (10px) base, with scaled variants
- **Focus indicators**: Ring color with 50% opacity for subtle focus states
- **Destructive/Error color**: Saturated red (`oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325)`)

### 5. SIDEBAR COMPONENT - Full Contents

**File:** `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/web/components/layout/sidebar.tsx`

```typescript
// web/components/layout/sidebar.tsx
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import {
  LayoutDashboard, FolderKanban, Package, Radio,
  Bell, Megaphone, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight,
} from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { useState } from "react";

const navItems = [
  { href: "/", label: "Dashboard", icon: LayoutDashboard },
  { href: "/projects", label: "Projects", icon: FolderKanban },
  { href: "/releases", label: "Releases", icon: Package },
  { href: "/sources", label: "Sources", icon: Radio },
  { href: "/subscriptions", label: "Subscriptions", icon: Bell },
  { href: "/channels", label: "Channels", icon: Megaphone },
];

export function Sidebar() {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState(false);

  return (
    <aside
      className={cn(
        "flex flex-col border-r bg-muted/30 transition-all duration-200",
        collapsed ? "w-16" : "w-56"
      )}
    >
      <div className="flex h-14 items-center border-b px-4">
        {!collapsed && (
          <Link href="/" className="flex items-center gap-2 font-semibold">
            <Package className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
            <span>ReleaseBeacon</span>
          </Link>
        )}
        <button
          onClick={() => setCollapsed(!collapsed)}
          className={cn(
            "ml-auto rounded-md p-1 hover:bg-muted",
            collapsed && "mx-auto"
          )}
        >
          {collapsed ? <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" /> : <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />}
        </button>
      </div>
      <nav className="flex-1 space-y-1 p-2">
        {navItems.map((item) => {
          const isActive =
            item.href === "/"
              ? pathname === "/"
              : pathname.startsWith(item.href);
          return (
            <Link
              key={item.href}
              href={item.href}
              className={cn(
                "flex items-center gap-3 rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm transition-colors",
                isActive
                  ? "bg-primary/10 text-primary font-medium"
                  : "text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground"
              )}
            >
              <item.icon className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
              {!collapsed && <span>{item.label}</span>}
            </Link>
          );
        })}
      </nav>
    </aside>
  );
}
```

**Features:**
- **Collapsible navigation**: Toggles between full width (w-56 / 224px) and icon-only (w-16 / 64px)
- **6 main navigation items**: Dashboard, Projects, Releases, Sources, Subscriptions, Channels
- **Active state detection**: Highlights current page based on pathname
- **Icons via Lucide React**: All items have visual icons
- **Smooth transitions**: 200ms animation on collapse/expand
- **Client-side interactivity**: Uses `useState` for collapse toggle and `usePathname` for active routing

**File:** `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/web/components/layout/header.tsx`

// web/components/layout/header.tsx
"use client";

import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";

const titles: Record<string, string> = {
  "/": "Dashboard",
  "/projects": "Projects",
  "/releases": "Releases",
  "/sources": "Sources",
  "/subscriptions": "Subscriptions",
  "/channels": "Channels",
};

export function Header() {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const segment = "/" + (pathname.split("/")[1] ?? "");
  const title = titles[segment] ?? "ReleaseBeacon";

  return (
    <header className="flex h-14 items-center border-b px-6">
      <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold">{title}</h1>
    </header>
  );
}
```

**Features:**
- Dynamic page title based on URL segment
- Fallback to "ReleaseBeacon" for unknown routes
- Fixed 56px height (h-14) with 24px padding

import { clsx, type ClassValue } from "clsx"
import { tailwind-merge } from "tailwind-merge"

export function cn(...inputs: ClassValue[]) {

}

### 11. NAVIGATION STRUCTURE (Sidebar)

The sidebar (`sidebar.tsx`) implements a 6-item navigation menu with collapsible behavior:

| Route | Label | Icon | Component |
|-------|-------|------|-----------|
| `/` | Dashboard | LayoutDashboard | Home page (stats, activity) |
| `/projects` | Projects | FolderKanban | List all projects with CRUD |
| `/releases` | Releases | Package | Global releases list |
| `/sources` | Sources | Radio | Global sources list |
| `/subscriptions` | Subscriptions | Bell | Notification subscriptions |
| `/channels` | Channels | Megaphone | Notification channels |

**Collapse behavior:**
- Full width (224px): Shows icon + label
- Collapsed (64px): Shows only icon
- Smooth transition: 200ms animation
- Active state: Primary color background (primary/10) + font-medium

### 12. KEY TECHNICAL DETAILS

**Build & Deployment:**
- Next.js `output: "export"` - Static export (embedded in Go binary)
- TypeScript strict mode enabled
- Path alias: `@/*` maps to project root

**Component Architecture:**
- shadcn/ui for all primitives (unstyled, built on Radix UI)
- Tailwind CSS 4 for styling
- CVA (class-variance-authority) for component variants
- Lucide React for icons

**API Integration:**
- Base URL: `process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || "/api/v1"`
- All requests include `Content-Type: application/json`
- Error handling with fallback error messages
- Typed responses via generic `ApiResponse<T>`

**Client Interactivity:**
- `usePathname()` for active route detection (Header, Sidebar)
- `useState` for UI state (sidebar collapse)
- `Link` from Next.js for SPA navigation
- No SSR data fetching (CSR only with potential SWR usage)

---

This comprehensive map covers all 24 page routes, 36 components, 15 UI primitives, and the complete API client surface. The frontend is modern, type-safe, and follows Next.js 16 / React 19 best practices.

/* 6px */\n\n  /* Core layout colors */\n  --background: #fafaf9;\n  --foreground: #111113;\n  --surface: #ffffff;\n  --sidebar-bg: #16181c;\n  --sidebar-text: #9ca3af;\n  --beacon-accent: #e8601a;\n  --border: #e8e8e5;\n  --mono-bg: #f3f3f1;\n  --text-secondary: #6b7280;\n  --text-muted: #9ca3af;\n\n  /* shadcn variable mappings */\n  --card: #ffffff;\n  --card-foreground: #111113;\n  --primary: #e8601a;\n  --primary-foreground: #ffffff;\n  --secondary: #f3f3f1;\n  --secondary-foreground: #374151;\n  --muted: #f3f3f1;\n  --muted-foreground: #6b7280;\n  --accent: #f3f3f1;\n  --accent-foreground: #111113;\n  --input: #e8e8e5;\n  --ring: #e8601a;\n\n  /* Status colors */\n  --status-completed: #16a34a;\n  --status-running: #2563eb;\n  --status-pending: #d97706;\n  --status-failed: #dc2626;\n}\n\n@layer base {\n  * {\n    @apply border-border outline-ring/50;\n  }\n  body {\n    @apply bg-background text-foreground;\n    font-family: var(--font-dm-sans), system-ui, sans-serif;\n  }\n}\n\n/* Motion primitives */\n@layer utilities {\n  .fade-in {\n    animation: fadeIn 150ms ease both;\n  }\n  @keyframes fadeIn {\n    from { opacity: 0; }\n    to { opacity: 1; }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### Step 2: Rewrite `layout.tsx`\n\nReplace Geist fonts with Fraunces + DM Sans. JetBrains Mono is loaded via fontsource CSS import in globals.css.\n\n```tsx\nimport type { Metadata } from \"next\";\nimport { Fraunces, DM_Sans } from \"next/font/google\";\nimport { Sidebar } from </div>\n        </div>\n      </body>\n    </html>\n  );\n}\n```\n\n### Step 3: Type-check\n\nRun: `cd web && npx tsc --noEmit`\nExpected: No errors.\n\n### Step 4: Build check\n\nRun: `cd web && npm     <div className=\"flex items-start gap-2\">\n        <Icon className=\"h-4 w-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0\" style={{ color: border }} />\n        <div>\n          <span className=\"font-semibold\" style={{  </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n```\n\n### Step 6: Type-check and commit\n\nRun: `cd web && npx tsc --noEmit`\nExpected: No errors.\n\n```bash\ncd web && git add components/ui/provider-badge.tsx sidebar (dark bg, accent border, 5 nav items)\"\n```\n\n---\n\n## Task 5: Header Redesign\n\n**Files:**\n- Modify: `web/components/layout/header.tsx`\n\n**Key changes vs current:**\n- White approach is to keep Header as-is for title and let each page page render its own action button at page level. The header just shows the breadcrumb.\n\n**Design note:** The header title comes from the URL. For nested pages like `/projects/[id]`, the header shows a breadcrumb. Since the header can't know project names without extra API calls, we'll show segment-based breadcrumbs (e.g. \"Projects / Detail\") and let full names appear in the page header zone.\n\n### Step 1: Rewrite `header.tsx`\n\n```tsx\n// web/components/layout/header.tsx\n\"use client\";\n\nimport { usePathname } from \"next/navigation\";\n\nconst SEGMENT_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {\n  \"\": \"Dashboard\",\n  projects: \"Projects\",\n  releases: \"Releases\",\n  sources: \"Sources\",\n  subscriptions: \"Subscriptions\",\n  channels: \"Channels\",\n  agent: \"Agent\",\n  \"semantic-releases\": \"Semantic Releases\",\n  \"context-sources\": \"Context Sources\",\n  new: \"New\",\n  edit: \"Edit\",\n};\n\nfunction segmentLabel(seg: string): string {\n  return SEGMENT_LABELS[seg] ?? seg;\n}\n\nexport function Header() {\n  const pathname = usePathname();\n  const segments = pathname.split(\"/\").filter(Boolean);\n\n  // Build breadcrumb skipping dynamic ID segments (UUIDs)\n  const uuidRe = /^[0-9a-f-]{8,}$/i;\n  const breadcrumbs = segments\n    .filter((s) => !uuidRe.test(s))\n    .map(segmentLabel);\n\n  const display =\n    breadcrumbs.length === 0\n      ? \"Dashboard\"\n      : breadcrumbs.join(\" / \");\n\n  return (\n    <header\n      className=\"flex h-12 items-center px-6\"\n      style={{ borderBottom: \"1px solid #e8e8e5\", backgroundColor: \"#ffffff\" }}\n    >\n      <p\n        className=\"text-[14px] font-medium text-[#111113]\"\n        style={{ fontFamily: \"var(--font-dm-sans)\" }}\n      >\n        {display}\n      </p>\n    </header>\n  );\n}\n```\n\n### Step 2: Type-check and commit\n\nRun: `cd web && npx tsc --noEmit`\n\n```bash\ncd web && git add components/layout/header.tsx\ngit commit -m \"feat(web): redesign — header (48px, breadcrumb, warm white)\"\n```\n\n---\n\n## Task 6: Dashboard Redesign\n\n**Files:**\n- Modify: `web/app/page.tsx`\n- Modify: `web/components/dashboard/stats-cards.tsx`\n- value: number | undefined;\n  icon: React.ElementType;\n}\n\nfunction StatCard({ label, value, icon: Icon }: StatCardProps) {\n  return (\n    <div\n      className=\"flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-md p-5\"\n      style={{ backgroundColor: \"#ffffff\", border: \"1px solid #e8e8e5\" }}\n    >\n      <div className=\"flex items-start justify-between\">\n        <p\n          className=\"text-[12px] uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-[#6b7280]\"\n          style={{ fontFamily: \"var(--font-dm-sans)\" }}\n        >\n          {label}\n        </p>\n        <Icon className=\"h-4 w-4 text-[#9ca3af]\"    </p>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nexport function StatsCards() {\n  const { data } = useSWR(\"stats\", () => system.stats());\n\n  const stats: Stats = data ?? {\n    total_releases: undefined as (\n                <p className=\"text-[14px] italic text-[#9ca3af]\" style={{ fontFamily: \"var(--font-fraunces)\" }}>\n                  No agent runs yet\n                </p>\n              ) : (\n                <TableContainer>\n                  <thead>\n                    <tr>\n                      <Th>Trigger</Th>\n                      <Th>Status</Th>\n                      <Th>Started</Th>\n                      <Th>Duration</Th>\n                      <Th>Semantic Release</Th>\n                    </tr>\n                  </thead>\n                  <tbody>\n                    {runList.map((run, i) => (\n                      <tr\n                        key={run.id}\n                        className=\"transition-colors duration-100 hover:bg-[#fafaf9]\"\n                        style={i > 0 ? { borderTop: \"1px solid #e8e8e5\" } : undefined}\n                      >\n                        <Td>{run.trigger_reason ?? \"manual\"}</Td>\n                        <Td>\n                          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5\">\n                            <StatusDot status={run.status} />\n                            <span>{run.status}</span>\n                          </div>\n                        </Td>\n                        <Td>{timeAgo(run.started_at)}</Td>\n                        <Td>{duration(run.started_at, run.completed_at)}</Td>\n                        <Td>\n                          {run.semantic_release_id ? (\n                            <Link\n                              href={`/projects/${projectId}/semantic-releases/${run.semantic_release_id}`}\n                              className=\"text-[#e8601a] hover:underline\"\n                              style={{ fontFamily: \"'JetBrains Mono', monospace\", fontSize: \"12px\" }}\n                            >\n                              View →\n                            </Link>\n                          ) : \"—\"}\n                        </Td>\n                      </tr>\n                    ))}\n                  </tbody>\n                </TableContainer>\n              )}\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        )}\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n```\n\n**Note on field access:** If any field path doesn't match the actual API types (e.g., `src.provider` vs `src.source_type`, `run.trigger_reason`), adjust to match the types in `lib/api/types.ts`. Semantic Releases\n      </p>\n\n      {/* Byline */}\n      <p\n        className=\"mb-1 text-[13px] text-[#9ca3af]\"\n        style={{ fontFamily: \"var(--font-fraunces)\", fontStyle: \"italic\" [];\n\n  // Fetch releases: use first project when \"all\" selected (API limitation)\n  const targetProjectId = selectedProject !== \"all\"\n    ? selectedProject\n    : projectList[0]?.id;\n\n  const { data: relData } = useSWR(\n    targetProjectId ? `releases-${targetProjectId}-${page}` : null,\n    () => releases.listByProject(targetProjectId!, { limit, offset: page * limit })\n  );\n\n  const items = relData?.data ?? [];\n  const total = relData?.meta?.total ?? 0;\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex flex-col gap-4 fade-in\">\n      {/* Page header */}\n      <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">\n        <h1\n          className=\"text-[24px] font-semibold text-[#111113]\"\n          style={{ fontFamily: \"var(--font-fraunces)\" }}\n        >\n          Releases\n        </h1>\n        <select\n          value={selectedProject}\n          onChange={(e) => { setSelectedProject(e.target.value); setPage(0); }}\n          className=\"rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-[13px] text-[#374151] outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#e8601a]\"\n          style={{ border: \"1px solid #e8e8e5\", fontFamily: \"var(--font-dm-sans)\", backgroundColor: \"#ffffff\" }}\n        >\n          <option value=\"all\">All Projects</option>\n          {projectList.map((p) => (\n            <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>{p.name}</option>\n          ))}\n        </select>\n      </div>\n\n      {/* Table */}\n      <div\n        className=\"overflow-hidden rounded-md\"\n        style={{ border: \"1px solid #e8e8e5\", backgroundColor: \"#ffffff\" }}\n      >\n        <table className=\"w-full text-[13px]\">\n          <thead>\n            <tr style={{ borderBottom: \"1px solid #e8e8e5\", backgroundColor: \"#fafaf9\" }}>\n              {[\"Project\", \"Provider\", \"Repository\", \"Version\", \"Released\", \"Age\"].map((h) => (\n                <th\n                  key={h}\n                  className=\"px-4 py-2.5 text-left text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-[#9ca3af]\"\n                >\n                  {h}\n                </th>\n              ))}\n            </tr>\n          </thead>\n          <tbody>\n            {items.length === 0 ? (\n              <tr>\n                <td colSpan={6} className=\"px-4 py-8 text-center text-[14px] italic text-[#9ca3af]\" style={{ fontFamily: \"var(--font-fraunces)\" }}>\n                  No releases found\n                </td>\n              </tr>\n            ) : (\n              items.map((r, i) => (\n                <tr\n                  key={r.id}\n                  className=\"transition-colors duration-100 hover:bg-[#fafaf9]\"\n                  style={i > 0 ? { borderTop: \"1px solid #e8e8e5\" } : undefined}\n                >\n                  <td className=\"px-4 py-2.5 text-[#374151]\" style={{ fontFamily: \"var(--font-dm-sans)\" }}>\n                    {r.project_name ?? selectedProject}\n                  </td>\n                  <td className=\"px-4 py-2.5\">\n                    <ProviderBadge provider={r.provider ?? \"\"} />\n                  </td>\n                  <td\n                    className=\"px-4 py-2.5 text-[12px] text-[#6b7280]\"\n                    style={{ fontFamily: \"'JetBrains Mono', monospace\" }}\n                  >\n                    {r.repository}\n                  </td>\n                  <td className=\"px-4 py-2.5\">\n                    <Link href={`/releases/${r.id}`}>\n                      <VersionChip version={r.version} />\n                    </Link>\n                  </td>\n                  <td className=\"px-4 py-2.5 text-[12px] text-[#9ca3af]\" style={{ fontFamily: \"var(--font-dm-sans)\" }}>\n                    {r.released_at ? new Date(r.released_at).toLocaleDateString() : \"—\"}\n                  </td>\n                  <td className=\"px-4 py-2.5 text-[12px] text-[#9ca3af]\" style={{ fontFamily: \"var(--font-dm-sans)\" }}>\n                    {timeAgo(r.released_at)}\n                  </td>\n                </tr>\n              ))\n            )}\n          </tbody>\n        </table>\n      </div>\n\n      {/* Pagination */}\n      {total > limit && (\n        <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between text-[13px] text-[#6b7280]\" style={{ fontFamily: \"var(--font-dm-sans)\" }}>\n          <span>\n            {page * limit + 1}–{Math.min((page + 1) * limit, total)} of {total}\n          </span>\n          <div className=\"flex gap-2\">\n            <button\n              disabled={page === 0}\n              onClick={() => setPage(p => p - 1)}\n              className=\"rounded px-3 py-1 transition-colors hover:bg-[#f3f3f1] disabled:opacity-40\"\n              style={{ border: \"1px solid #e8e8e5\" }}\n            >\n              Previous\n            </button>\n            <button\n              disabled={(page + 1) * limit >= total}\n              onClick={() => setPage(p => p + 1)}\n              className=\"rounded px-3 py-1 transition-colors hover:bg-[#f3f3f1] disabled:opacity-40\"\n              style={{ border: \"1px solid #e8e8e5\" }}\n            >\n              Next\n            </button>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n```\n\n### Step 3: Redesign release detail page\n\nRead `web/app/releases/[id]/page.tsx` (or Add type badges with distinct per-type colors.\n\n```tsx\n// web/app/channels/page.tsx\n\"use client\";\n\nimport Link from \"next/link\";\nimport useSWR from \"swr\";\nimport { channels } from \"@/lib/api/client\";\nimport { Plus, Pencil, Trash2 } from \"lucide-react\";\n\nconst TYPE_COLORS: Record<string, { bg: string; text: string }> = {\n  slack: { bg: \"#4A154B\", text: \"#ffffff\" },\n  discord: { bg: \"#5865F2\", text: \"#ffffff\" },\n  webhook: { bg: \"#1a1a1a\", text: \"#ffffff\" },\n};\n\nfunction TypeBadge({ type }: { type: string }) {\n  const style = TYPE_COLORS[type.toLowerCase()] ?? { bg: \"#6b7280\", text: \"#ffffff\" };\n  return (\n    <span\n      className=\"inline-flex items-center rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium capitalize\"\n      style={{ backgroundColor: style.bg, color: style.text }}\n    >\n      {type}\n    </span>\n  );\n}\n\nfunction configSummary(config: Record<string, unknown>): string {\n  return Object.entries(config)\n    .slice(0, 2)\n    .map(([k, v]) => `${k}: ${String(v).slice(0, 30)}`)\n    .join(\", \");\n}\n\nexport default function ChannelsPage() {\n  const { data, mutate } = useSWR(\"channels\", () => channels.list());\n  const items = data?.data ?? [];\n\n  async function handleDelete(id: string) {\n    if (!confirm(\"Delete this channel?\")) return;\n    await channels.delete(id);\n    mutate();\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex flex-col gap-4 fade-in\">\n      <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">\n        <h1\n          className=\"text-[24px] font-semibold text-[#111113]\"\n          style={{ fontFamily: \"var(--font-fraunces)\" }}\n        >\n          Channels\n        </h1>\n        <Link\n          href=\"/channels/new\"\n          className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded px-3 py-1.5 text-[13px] text-white transition-opacity hover:opacity-90\"\n          style={{ backgroundColor: \"#e8601a\", fontFamily: \"var(--font-dm-sans)\" }}\n        >\n          <Plus className=\"h-3.5 w-3.5\" />\n          New Channel\n        </Link>\n      </div>\n\n      <div\n        className=\"overflow-hidden rounded-md\"\n        style={{ border: \"1px solid #e8e8e5\", backgroundColor: \"#ffffff\" }}\n      >\n        <table className=\"w-full text-[13px]\" style={{ fontFamily: \"var(--font-dm-sans)\" }}>\n          <thead>\n            <tr style={{ borderBottom: \"1px solid #e8e8e5\", backgroundColor: \"#fafaf9\" }}>\n              {[\"Name\", \"Type\", \"Config\", \"Created\", \"\"].map((h) => (\n                <th key={h} className=\"px-4 py-2.5 text-left text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-[#9ca3af]\">\n                  {h}\n                </th>\n              ))}\n            </tr>\n          </thead>\n          <tbody>\n            {items.length === 0 ? (\n              <tr>\n                <td colSpan={5} className=\"px-4 py-8 text-center text-[14px] italic text-[#9ca3af]\" style={{ fontFamily: \"var(--font-fraunces)\" }}>\n                  No channels yet — add one to receive notifications\n                </td>\n              </tr>\n            ) : (\n              items.map((ch, i) => (\n                <tr\n                  key={ch.id}\n                  className=\"transition-colors duration-100 hover:bg-[#fafaf9]\"\n                  style={i > 0 ? { borderTop: \"1px solid #e8e8e5\" } : undefined}\n                >\n                  <td className=\"px-4 py-2.5 font-medium text-[#111113]\">{ch.name}</td>\n                  <td className=\"px-4 py-2.5\"><TypeBadge type={ch.type} /></td>\n                  <td\n                    className=\"max-w-[280px] truncate px-4 py-2.5 text-[12px] text-[#9ca3af]\"\n                    style={{ fontFamily: \"'JetBrains Mono', monospace\" }}\n                  >\n                    {ch.config ? configSummary(ch.config as Record<string, unknown>) : \"—\"}\n                  </td>\n                  <td className=\"px-4 py-2.5 text-[12px] text-[#9ca3af]\">\n                    {new Date(ch.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}\n                  </td>\n                  <td className=\"px-4 py-2.5\">\n                    <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n                      <Link href={`/channels/${ch.id}/edit`} className=\"rounded p-1 text-[#9ca3af] transition-colors hover:text-[#374151]\">\n                        <Pencil className=\"h-3.5 w-3.5\" />\n                      </Link>\n                      <button\n                        onClick={() => handleDelete(ch.id)}\n                        className=\"rounded p-1 text-[#9ca3af] transition-colors hover:text-[#dc2626]\"\n                      >\n                        <Trash2 className=\"h-3.5 w-3.5\" />\n                      </button>\n                    </div>\n                  </td>\n                </tr>\n              ))\n            )}\n          </tbody>\n        </table>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n```\n\n### Step 2: Rewrite `app/subscriptions/page.tsx`\n\nApply the same table pattern with type badges (source/project), channel name lookup, mono version filter display, and a \"+ New Subscription\" button linking to `/subscriptions/new`.\n\nUse the same structural pattern as channels above: `useSWR` for both `subscriptions.list()` and `channels.list()` (needed for channel name resolution). # Frontend Redesign Code Review

**Branch:** `feature/frontend-redesign` (10 commits, 20 files, +2555/-826 lines)
**Build:** Passes (`next build` succeeds)
**Type checking:** Passes (`tsc --noEmit` zero errors)

---

## What Was Done Well

The redesign is a substantial improvement. Acknowledging the positives first:

1. **Clean commit history.** Ten well-scoped, logically sequenced commits -- tokens first, then micro-components, then layout, then page by page. Each commit message is descriptive and follows a consistent format.

2. **Design spec compliance is strong.** The color system, three-font typography, sidebar dimensions, header height, dashboard two-column layout, semantic release editorial page, and tab structure all match the spec closely.

3. **Type safety is excellent.** TypeScript type checking passes cleanly. The API client types (`/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/lib/api/types.ts`) are well-structured, and components use proper typed props throughout. The `SRRow extends SemanticRelease` pattern in the dashboard is a clean way to handle enriched data.

4. **Shared micro-components are well-designed.** All five (`ProviderBadge`, `StatusDot`, `VersionChip`, `SectionLabel`, `UrgencyCallout`) are small, focused, accept `className` for composability, and use `cn()` for merging. Fallback handling (unknown provider gets gray) is defensive.

5. **API client architecture.** The `request<T>` generic wrapper in `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/lib/api/client.ts` is clean and the namespaced API objects (`projects`, `sources`, `releases`, etc.) read well.

---

## Critical Issues (Must Fix)

### C1. Broken CSS variable `--font-jetbrains-mono` -- renders as default font

**Files:**
- `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/app/channels/page.tsx` (line 161)
- `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/app/subscriptions/page.tsx` (line 179)

These two files reference `var(--font-jetbrains-mono)`, but this CSS variable is **never defined**. JetBrains Mono is loaded via `@fontsource/jetbrains-mono` (a static CSS import), not via `next/font`, so there is no `--font-jetbrains-mono` variable injected. The result is that the `fontFamily` value resolves to nothing, and the browser falls back to the default font.

Every other file in the codebase correctly uses the literal string `"'JetBrains Mono', monospace"` for the same purpose. These two files are inconsistent.

```tsx
// channels/page.tsx line 161 -- BROKEN
fontFamily: "var(--font-jetbrains-mono)",

// subscriptions/page.tsx line 179 -- BROKEN  
fontFamily: sub.version_filter ? "var(--font-jetbrains-mono)" : "var(--font-dm-sans)",

// Should be:
fontFamily: "'JetBrains Mono', monospace",
```

### C2. `--accent` CSS variable diverges from design spec meaning

**File:** `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/app/globals.css` (line 65)

The design spec defines `--accent` as `#e8601a` (orange). The implementation maps `--accent` to `#f3f3f1` (the mono background gray) for shadcn compatibility, and introduces a separate `--beacon-accent: #e8601a`. This is a deliberate deviation for shadcn integration, but it means any shadcn component using `accent` will get gray, not orange. This is likely intentional but worth documenting -- anyone reading the spec and then looking at CSS will be confused. The variable `--beacon-accent` is defined but never referenced outside of `globals.css` (line 34, `--color-beacon-accent: var(--beacon-accent)`). If it exists to be a usable token, it is currently unused.

---

## Important Issues (Should Fix)

### I1. Inconsistent primary text color: `#1a1a1a` vs `#111113`

The design spec defines `--text-primary: #111113` for headings and primary body text. However, many components use `#1a1a1a` instead:

- `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/app/page.tsx` (lines 81, 126)
- `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/components/dashboard/stats-cards.tsx` (line 54)
- `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/components/dashboard/recent-releases.tsx` (line 91)
- `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/app/releases/page.tsx` (lines 136, 154, 240)
- `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/components/releases/release-detail.tsx` (lines 126, 183, 234, 326)

Meanwhile, other files correctly use `#111113`:
- `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/app/channels/page.tsx`
- `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/app/subscriptions/page.tsx`
- `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/components/semantic-releases/semantic-release-detail.tsx`
- `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/components/projects/project-detail.tsx`

The difference is visually subtle but it is a consistency issue. One color should be chosen, and all files should use it. Per the spec, `#111113` is correct.

### I2. Font references via hardcoded strings instead of CSS variables

The `semantic-release-detail.tsx` file uses hardcoded font family strings like `'DM Sans', sans-serif` and `'Fraunces', serif` instead of the CSS custom properties `var(--font-dm-sans)` and `var(--font-fraunces)`:

- `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/components/semantic-releases/semantic-release-detail.tsx` -- 13 instances of `'DM Sans', sans-serif`, 3 instances of `'Fraunces', serif`

Every other file uses the CSS variable form. The hardcoded strings will still work because the fonts are loaded globally, but they bypass the CSS variable abstraction. If the font ever changes, these would need manual updates while the variable-based references would update automatically. More importantly, it creates an inconsistent codebase pattern -- a maintainer looking at this file would assume a different approach than the rest of the codebase.

### I3. `timeAgo` utility duplicated five times

The `timeAgo` function is copy-pasted in five separate files:
- `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/app/page.tsx` (line 16)
- `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/components/dashboard/recent-releases.tsx` (line 14)
- `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/app/releases/page.tsx` (line 19)
- `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/components/releases/release-detail.tsx` (line 20)
- `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/components/semantic-releases/semantic-release-detail.tsx` (line 12)

Two variants exist: one accepts `string` and one accepts `string | null | undefined`. This should be extracted to a shared utility, e.g., `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/lib/utils.ts` or a new `lib/format.ts`.

### I4. Letter-spacing inconsistency: `0.12em` vs `0.05em` vs `tracking-wider` vs `tracking-wide`

The design spec defines section labels with `letter-spacing: 0.12em`. The `SectionLabel` component correctly uses `tracking-[0.12em]`. However, table headers use three different letter-spacing approaches:

| File | Approach | Value |
|------|----------|-------|
| `semantic-release-detail.tsx` | `tracking-[0.12em]` (Tailwind arbitrary) | 0.12em -- matches spec |
| `channels/page.tsx`, `subscriptions/page.tsx`, `releases/page.tsx` | `letterSpacing: "0.05em"` (inline style) | 0.05em -- deviates from spec |
| `project-detail.tsx` | `tracking-wider` (Tailwind utility) | 0.05em (Tailwind default) |
| `stats-cards.tsx` | `tracking-wide` (Tailwind utility) | 0.025em (Tailwind default) |

The spec says 0.12em for section labels. Table headers are arguably a different element, but using 3-4 different values for what is essentially the same "uppercase muted header" pattern is inconsistent. Consider using `SectionLabel` or a shared `table-header` class for all table column headers.

### I5. Loading states use text "Loading..." instead of skeleton shimmers

The design spec (Section 8, "Shared Component Patterns") explicitly states: "Loading states: Skeleton shimmer bars matching content shape -- no spinners." All loading states across the codebase show plain text "Loading..." instead. This is a spec deviation.

Files affected:
- `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/app/page.tsx`
- `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/app/releases/page.tsx`
- `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/app/channels/page.tsx`
- `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/app/subscriptions/page.tsx`
- `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/components/dashboard/recent-releases.tsx`
- `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/components/releases/release-detail.tsx`
- `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/components/semantic-releases/semantic-release-detail.tsx`
- `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/components/projects/project-detail.tsx`

And `StatsCards` uses `"..."` (unicode middle dots) which is a reasonable placeholder for numbers but still not the specified skeleton bars.

### I6. Stats card "Total Projects" uses AlertTriangle icon -- misleading

In `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/components/dashboard/stats-cards.tsx` (line 23):

```tsx
{ label: "Total Projects", value: stats?.total_projects ?? "\u2014", icon: AlertTriangle },
```

The design spec lists the fourth stat as "Failed Jobs" (`pending_agent_runs` is used as "Pending Jobs", but the fourth slot was supposed to be failed jobs). The implementation changed it to "Total Projects" but kept the `AlertTriangle` icon. A warning triangle icon for "Total Projects" is confusing -- it suggests something is wrong. Use a neutral icon like `FolderKanban` or `Layers`.

### I7. Dashboard recent releases table rows not linkable

The design spec says the recent releases table rows should link to `/releases/[id]`. In `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/components/dashboard/recent-releases.tsx`, the rows are plain `<div>` elements with no `<Link>` wrapper and no click handler. Users cannot navigate to a release detail from the dashboard's recent releases table.

---

## Suggestions (Nice to Have)

### S1. Inline styles vs Tailwind arbitrary values -- pick one approach

The codebase mixes three styling approaches for the same kind of declarations:
- Tailwind classes: `text-[13px] text-[#6b7280]`
- Inline `style` objects: `style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-dm-sans)", color: "#6b7280" }}`
- Both on the same element

This is understandable given Tailwind's limitations with CSS variables for `fontFamily`, but when the same hex color appears both as `text-[#6b7280]` (Tailwind) and `color: "#6b7280"` (inline style) in the same file, it makes the styling harder to audit. Consider establishing a convention: all design token colors via Tailwind arbitrary values, font-family via inline style only where needed.

### S2. Header lacks the "action button slot" from spec

The design spec (Section 3) mentions: "Right: primary action button slot (contextual per page)." The header implementation in `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/components/layout/header.tsx` only renders a breadcrumb on the left side. No slot or mechanism for page-specific action buttons is provided. This could be added later via React context or a portal, but it is a spec gap.

### S3. Empty states could use the spec's "action button" pattern

The design spec says: "Empty states: Fraunces italic 16px muted, centered, with contextual action button." The current empty states correctly use Fraunces italic muted text, but most omit the contextual action button (e.g., "No releases yet" could include a link to configure sources).

### S4. `as const` assertion on `textTransform`

In `/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/app/releases/page.tsx` (line 213):

```tsx
textTransform: "uppercase" as const,
```

The `as const` is unnecessary here -- TypeScript already narrows string literal types in object literal positions for `CSSProperties`. This is harmless but it is the only place in the codebase with this pattern, suggesting it was a one-off workaround rather than a deliberate pattern.

### S5. `confirm()` for destructive actions

Multiple files use browser `confirm()` for delete operations. This works but is visually jarring against the polished editorial aesthetic. A custom confirmation modal using the existing shadcn dialog primitives would be more cohesive. Not blocking, but worth considering.

### S6. Shadcn `--accent` semantic conflict

As noted in C2, the shadcn variable `--accent` is set to `#f3f3f1` (gray), not the design system's accent orange. This means any shadcn component using `bg-accent` will render gray, not orange. If the project uses shadcn dropdowns, popovers, or other components that rely on `--accent`, the visual result may be unexpected. Consider mapping `--accent` to the orange and using a different variable for the secondary gray, or documenting this divergence clearly.

Page "/projects/[id]/page" is missing param "/projects/[id]" in "generateStaticParams()", which is required with "output: export" config.

The fix is simple — `output: "export"` is only needed for production (Go binary embeds the static files). In dev mode, it just breaks dynamic routing for no benefit.

> TOOL

tool_use Edit

```json

  "file_path": "/Users/pc/web3/ReleaseBeacon/.worktrees/frontend-redesign/web/next.config.ts",
  "old_string": "const nextConfig: NextConfig = {\n  output: \"export\",\n};",
  "new_string": "const nextConfig: NextConfig = {\n  output: process.env.NODE_ENV === \"production\" ? \"export\" : undefined,\n};"
}
